constraint_text: During work on the Interdisciplinary Comparative Query Resolution project in the Multi-Hop Synthesis phase, invocations of `literary_verse_finder` must be paired with simultaneous invocations of `event_city_identifier` in the same action, and `park_feature_locator` may only be called after `biographical_data_retriever` has executed; the final response must contain the keyword "Delimiting Identifier: [Comparison Result]", be between 300 and 500 characters in length, and end with an exclamation mark.
